Configuration of soilhub

Source: R/config.R
soilhub-config.Rd

Every setting is resolved with the precedence explicit argument > options() > environment variable > built-in default.

SettingArgumentOptionEnvironment variableDefault
API base URLapi_urlsoilhub.api_urlSOILHUB_API_URLhttps://soilhub.weatherprogapp.it/api/v1
Keycloak realmkeycloak_urlsoilhub.keycloak_urlSOILHUB_KEYCLOAK_URLhttps://kc.weatherprogapp.it/realms/ams
OIDC clientclient_idsoilhub.client_idSOILHUB_CLIENT_IDams-r
Request timeout (seconds)timeoutsoilhub.timeoutSOILHUB_TIMEOUT300
Verbosityverbosesoilhub.verboseSOILHUB_VERBOSE1 when interactive, else 0
Export directorydirsoilhub.export_dirSOILHUB_EXPORT_DIRfile.path(tempdir(), "soilhub-exports")
Page sizepage_sizesoilhub.page_size–the server's max_page_size (1000 when unknown)
Proactive refresh margin (seconds)–soilhub.refresh_marginSOILHUB_REFRESH_MARGIN60

Verbosity levels: 0 silent; 1 user messages (pages read, retries, session renewed, export progress); 2 also one line per HTTP request (method, path, status, duration, request id), never headers, bodies or tokens. TRUE means 1 and FALSE 0. Messages have class soilhub_message and can be silenced with suppressMessages(). A session created without an explicit verbose follows soilhub.verbose at each call, so options(soilhub.verbose = 2) turns request logging on for an existing session.

The timeout is the total time allowed for one request (connection 10 s); long pages over whole datasets take 40–90 s.

The refresh margin is how long before the expiry of the access token the next request renews it (see soil_connect()); it is read at each request, so it applies to existing sessions too. A margin longer than the token lifetime renews the token before every request.

The variable names of soilhub 0.1.x are read as a fallback, with a one-time message: SOIL_API_URL for the API base URL, KEYCLOAK_TOKEN_URL and KEYCLOAK_DEVICE_URL for the Keycloak realm (the realm is the part before /protocol/openid-connect/).

See also

Other configuration and errors: soilhub-errors

Examples

# Use a test API for the rest of the R session
old <- options(soilhub.api_url = "http://localhost:8000/api/v1")
options(old)

# Log every request
old <- options(soilhub.verbose = 2)
options(old)
